description:
Command-line Git information tool

Onefetch is a command-line Git information tool written in Rust that displays project information and code statistics for a local Git repository directly to your terminal.
The tool is completely offline - no network access is required.
What's Changed
Bug Fixes
- Fix a crash when --ascii-input is empty or only whitespace by @o2sh in #1898
- Fix --languages and --ascii-language listing languages in random order, a regression since 2.28.0 by @o2sh in #1890
- --number-of-languages now also applies to -o json and -o yaml by @o2sh in #1884
CI/CD
- onefetch-ascii, onefetch-image and onefetch-manifest are merged into onefetch and no longer published (last version: 3.0.0) by @o2sh in #1884
- Release binaries are built with LTO and stripped on all platforms by @o2sh in #1891
Chores
- Replace unmaintained winres with winresource by @o2sh in #1896
Full Changelog: 3.0.0...3.1.0
